edges.instruction: Follow the long corridor towards the Cafeteria. The Gallery Area opens off it on the way.
edges.instructionRev: Follow the long corridor back towards Reception 2.

edges.instruction: Take the narrow passage between the studios and the amphitheatre.
edges.instructionRev: Come down the passage to the main corridor.

edges.instruction: Follow the bent wing, keeping the Maker's Hives beside you.
edges.instructionRev: Follow the bent wing back down towards the studios.

edges.instruction: Walk along the top of the amphitheatre.
edges.instructionRev: Walk back along the top of the amphitheatre.

edges.instruction: Go down the steps into the amphitheatre.
edges.instructionRev: Climb the steps out of the amphitheatre.

edges.instruction: Go up through the gap between the Teacher's Cubicle and Reception 2.
edges.instructionRev: Come back down past Reception 2 to the corridor.

edges.instruction: Go through the Library Entrance, beside the Teacher's Cubicle.
edges.instructionRev: Leave the library through the Library Entrance.

edges.instruction: Follow the corridor towards Reception.
edges.instructionRev: Follow the corridor towards the Infirmary end.

edges.instruction: The Infirmary is at the end of the corridor.
edges.instructionRev: Come out of the Infirmary into the corridor.

edges.instruction: Go out through the north door.
edges.instructionRev: Go in through the north door of the main block.

edges.instruction: Take the path across to the Football Field.
edges.instructionRev: Take the path back to the main block.

edges.instruction: Go out through the main doors onto the forecourt.
edges.instructionRev: Go in through the main doors of the block.

edges.instruction: Cross the forecourt, past the planters.
edges.instructionRev: Cross the forecourt towards the main doors.

edges.instruction: Walk down to the Main Gate.
edges.instructionRev: Come in from the Main Gate and walk up to the forecourt.

edges.instruction: Go through the doors into the Atelier wing.
edges.instructionRev: Come out of the Atelier wing into the main corridor.

edges.instruction: Follow the corridor along the bottom of the courtyard.
edges.instructionRev: Follow the corridor back towards the Atelier doors.

edges.instruction: Go round the top of the courtyard.
edges.instructionRev: Go round the top of the courtyard.

edges.instruction: Follow the corridor up the far side of the courtyard, past the washrooms.
edges.instructionRev: Follow the corridor back down towards the Atelier doors.

edges.instruction: Climb the First Floor Stairs. You come out on the first floor opposite Reception 2.
edges.instructionRev: Take the stairs down to the ground floor. You come out beside Reception.

edges.instruction: Climb the Cafeteria Stairs to the first floor. You come out in the lobby behind Reception 2.
edges.instructionRev: Take the Cafeteria Stairs down to the ground floor. You come out at the Infirmary end of the corridor.

edges.instruction: Take the lift up to the first floor. You come out in the corridor by Reception 2.
edges.instructionRev: Take the lift down to the ground floor. You come out beside Reception.
